question: Where is Idris mentioned in the Quran?
answer: Idris is mentioned by name 2 times in 2 ayahs of the Quran.
name: Idris

evidence.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيّٗا
evidence.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
evidence.de: Und gedenke im Buch Idris’. Er war ein Wahrhaftiger und Prophet.

evidence.ar: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدۡرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ كُلّٞ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
evidence.en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
evidence.de: Und (auch) Isma’il und Idris und Du’l-Kifl. Jeder gehörte zu den Standhaften.
